subject: Hosted API evaluation — traffic envelope & quickstart next steps
messages:
From: Alicia Wang <alicia@freshcart.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: FreshCart quick follow on deployment fit (traffic envelope + SLOs)

Thanks again for the demo today — Jordan and team. Quick recap from our side and a few clarifying questions to help us decide whether to start with Hosted or push for Dedicated/VPC later in the pilot.

What we shared today:
- Typical user flows: search/autocomplete + cart assistance + answer synthesis in support chat.
- Expected peak RPS: ~220 reqs/sec for short chat completions during promos (2x daily spikes)
- Typical payload: 80–200 tokens input, expected 150–600 tokens generated per call

Questions we need answered to decide on Hosted vs Dedicated: 
1) Can Hosted sustain ~220 RPS with 95th p99 latencies under 250ms for short completions?
2) How do token-based rate limits translate to concurrent requests and recommended endpoint sizing?
3) What are our quickstart options for sandbox endpoints and how fast can we get a prefixed KV/prefix cache configured?
4) Data residency and logs: can we limit retention for trial logs (we're EU customers for data at rest eventually)

Attachments: FreshCart-Roadmap.pdf (high level product roadmap), I can share a traffic spreadsheet if useful — attaching a short one next.

Next steps from our side: Alicia (me) to share traffic profile spreadsheet and a preferred 2-week pilot window.

Thanks,
Alicia Wang
Head of ML Infrastructure
FreshCart

Attachment: FreshCart-Roadmap.pdf (pdf)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Wang <alicia@freshcart.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 18:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FreshCart quick follow on deployment fit (traffic envelope + SLOs)

Alicia — great questions and thanks for the doc. Short answers up front, details below and next actions.

TL;DR:
- Hosted can support your pilot and typical spikes; we'll propose sandbox endpoints sized for your peak envelope and tune rate limits.
- For the pilot we recommend Hosted quickstart (sandbox + prefetched KV) — Dedicated/VPC becomes worth it once sustained production throughput or stricter tenancy/SLA needs arise.

Details:
1) Performance: For the profile you shared (short completions) we can route to a low-latency model variant and keep p99 under ~250–300ms for RPCs that generate <=~300 tokens if requests are batched and prefix caching is enabled. If you exceed ~500 tokens regularly, latency increases and Dedicated may be better.
2) Rate limits: Our Hosted tiers are expressed as tokens-per-minute and concurrent RPS heuristics. For planning, 220 RPS with average 300 tokens output maps to ~4M tokens/minute during the peak window — we'll need the traffic spreadsheet to size an initial sandbox slice. For the pilot we can temporarily raise ratecap for the sandbox.
3) Quickstart: We can provision sandbox endpoints within 48 hours after we get a traffic profile and your list of test API keys. We can pre-configure a prefix KV/cache and example prompt templates as part of the quickstart.
4) Data residency/logs: Hosted stores trial logs for 30 days by default; we can shorten retention for the sandbox to 7 days and filter logs for the pilot. EU-at-rest options are available on Dedicated/Private.

Next actions (I can own):
- Alicia: share the traffic spreadsheet (sample cols: timestamp, requests, avg input tokens, avg output tokens) — you mentioned you'd send one.
- Marissa: can you confirm if we can provision a sandbox with elevated ratecap and the prefetched KV in ~48h?
- I'll open a HubSpot play (link below) and schedule a 30-min follow-up to agree on pilot window.

Quick links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Marissa / Jordan / Alicia — thanks, looping in details and a clear pilot suggestion.

Short answer: we can stand up a sandbox and accommodate the early spikes on Hosted. Specifics below.

Sandbox plan (48h target after approvals):
- Two sandbox endpoints: freshcart-sbox-search and freshcart-sbox-chat. Partitioning keeps search traffic (short completions) separate from chat/dialog for quota isolation.
- Initial ratecaps: soft cap 3,500 requests/min per endpoint (burstable), token ceiling 6M tokens/min across both endpoints; we can increase temporarily for your pilot window.
- Prefetch/KV: we can pre-warm KV prefix caching for common product prompts — add your top 500 SKUs list and we'll upload.
- Observability: provide a short dashboard (token usage, p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate) and a CSV export for your logs.

Recommendation on Hosted vs Dedicated:
- Start on Hosted quickstart during pilot (less procurement friction). If after pilot you see sustained >10M tokens/day for several weeks or require VPC + co-tenancy for compliance, we'll move to Dedicated.

Action items:
- Alicia: please upload the traffic spreadsheet (freshcart-traffic-profile.xlsx) and top-500 SKUs CSV to the Drive link below. Once uploaded, I'll kick off the sandbox provisioning.
- Marissa: I'll coordinate with infra to pre-configure KV and elevate ratecap for the pilot window.
- Jordan: please confirm pilot window times in HubSpot so we can calendar infra availability.

Links: Sandbox runbook — https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c4d
